_comment: Curated topic taxonomy for Dawn 1990-1992. Replaces the BERTopic auto-generated underscore-strings (kgs_grams_oil_40 etc.) with stable human-readable labels. Each entry has: id (stable int), key (slug), label (display), description (one-line for Gemini), keywords (search hints).

topics.label: Pakistan Politics
topics.description: Domestic Pakistani politics: PPP, MQM, IJI, federal/provincial governments, Bhutto, Sharif, party affairs, elections, assemblies.

topics.label: Foreign Relations
topics.description: Pakistan's bilateral diplomacy, foreign-ministry statements, UN, embassies, visits by foreign leaders, treaties.

topics.label: Kashmir
topics.description: Kashmir dispute, line of control, Indian-occupied Kashmir, Hurriyat, militancy, Pakistan–India tensions over Kashmir.

topics.label: Afghanistan
topics.description: Afghan civil war, mujahideen factions, Najibullah, Kabul, refugees, post-Soviet-withdrawal politics, Geneva accords.

topics.label: Middle East
topics.description: Gulf War, Iraq–Kuwait, Iran, Israel–Palestine, Saudi Arabia, Arab League, OPEC politics (not oil prices).

topics.label: Cold War & USSR
topics.description: Soviet Union breakup, Eastern Europe revolutions, Gorbachev, Yeltsin, US–USSR summits, German reunification.

topics.label: Defence & Military
topics.description: Pakistani armed forces, military exercises, weapons procurement, defence budget, retired officer affairs.

topics.label: Stock Market
topics.description: Karachi Stock Exchange, share prices, dividends, modarabas, IPOs, market closing reports.

topics.label: Currency & Forex
topics.description: Foreign exchange rates, dollar, yen, sterling, kerb market, gold prices.

topics.label: Oil & Energy Markets
topics.description: OPEC quotas, oil prices, petroleum products, refining, fuel imports.

topics.label: Budget & Tax
topics.description: Federal/provincial budgets, taxation policy, customs duties, fiscal measures.

topics.label: IMF & External Debt
topics.description: IMF programmes, World Bank loans, foreign debt, structural adjustment, balance of payments.

topics.label: Corporate Finance
topics.description: Company AGMs, board notices, dividends, mergers, listed-company financials.

topics.label: Agriculture & Commodities
topics.description: Cotton, wheat, rice, sugar, ginning, export prices, food grains, crop reports.

topics.label: Shipping & Trade
topics.description: Cargo, container traffic, port operations (KPT), shipping companies, exports/imports.

topics.label: Industry & Manufacturing
topics.description: Textile mills, cement, steel, fertilizer, chemicals, factory output, productivity.

topics.label: Real Estate & Property
topics.description: Property listings, plot/house sales, Defence/Clifton/Gulshan, real-estate agents.

topics.label: Tenders & Classifieds
topics.description: Public tenders, government procurement notices, situations-vacant, want-ads.

topics.label: Job Listings
topics.description: Situations vacant, recruitment ads with experience requirements and how to apply.

topics.label: Crime & Violence
topics.description: Murders, killings, riots, sectarian violence, kidnappings, police actions, terrorism.

topics.label: Education
topics.description: Schools, colleges, universities, exam results (intermediate/matric), teacher affairs.

topics.label: Health & Medicine
topics.description: Hospitals, doctors, public health, disease outbreaks, drug regulation, medical strikes.

topics.label: Women's Issues
topics.description: Women's rights, women in workforce, motherhood, maternal health, gender debates.

topics.label: Obituaries & Condolences
topics.description: Death notices, condolence messages, soyem/chehlum announcements.

topics.label: Utilities (Power & Water)
topics.description: Electricity (KESC/WAPDA), load-shedding, gas, water supply (KWSB), tariffs.

topics.label: Telecom
topics.description: Telephone services, exchanges, subscribers, billing, telegraph, postal.

topics.label: Transport
topics.description: Roads, traffic, public transport, driving schools, KCR, transport policy.

topics.label: Nuclear Programme
topics.description: PAEC, nuclear energy, radiation, atomic research, nuclear non-proliferation talks.

topics.label: Technology
topics.description: Computers, IBM, software, IT services, business machinery quotations.

topics.label: Automotive
topics.description: Car ads, Suzuki/Toyota models, dealer notices, vehicle listings.

topics.label: Consumer Electronics
topics.description: Refrigerators, air-conditioners, VCRs, TVs, household appliances.

topics.label: Cricket
topics.description: Cricket matches, tours, Pakistan team, World Cup, batting/bowling reports.

topics.label: Other Sports
topics.description: Hockey, football, squash, tennis, athletics — anything other than cricket.

topics.label: Arts & Culture
topics.description: Exhibitions, paintings, music, film, theatre, arts council.

topics.label: Media & Broadcasting
topics.description: Radio (PBC), PTV, news transmission schedules, media policy.

topics.label: Legal Notices
topics.description: Court notices, claim objections, legal advertisements, public notices.

topics.label: Weather
topics.description: Weather forecasts, monsoon updates, temperature reports.

topics.label: Puzzles & Crosswords
topics.description: Crosswords, chess problems, bridge columns.

topics.label: Other / Uncategorised
topics.description: Routine listings, schedules, or short snippets that do not fit any other topic.
